messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: canary error_rate > 3% for POST /v1/generate in prod-us-east (policy=canary-errors) :rotating_light:

deploy-bot: canary rollout started by derek at 2026-09-14T19:27:10Z — version=rev-2026-09-14-4b2c

derek: kicking a 5% canary for the proxy-routing change. small traffic slice, monitoring.

alex_chen: alex here (oncall) — ACKing the page, pulling traces. which header change went out? @derek

maria: seeing a 502/504 spike on the canary slice starting ~19:29, Datadog panels show ~3.5% 5xx for canary hosts

sre-rotation: logs from canary proxy-1:
```
2026-09-14T19:29:34Z ERROR upstream request failed: connection reset by peer
2026-09-14T19:29:35Z WARN missing header: X-Session-Affinity
```

derek: patched in session-affinity header usage to improve kv-cache hit rate. maybe older clients don't send header yet.

maria: FYI support is getting customer tickets for timeouts/500s — flagging customer impact.

katie_support: customers reporting errors: omega-llc, ember-app. ticket volume up.

alex_chen: quick triage — two things: (1) the new routing header mismatch causing 502s, (2) alert noise — the same canary policy fired 6x in 4m. grouping looks broken.

sre-rotation: digging into Datadog: dashboards show canary error_rate with tag key 'region:us-east', alerts query uses 'env:prod region:us-east-1c' combo. tag mismatch -> alert window aggregation not matching panel.

maria: so panels looked fine but alerts repeated because the alert query was looking at different tagset and shorter window. noisy paging during deploy.

derek: immediate mitigation — pause canary and flip feature flag for new-routing OFF. running kill-switch now.

# deploy commands from derek:
```
$ ffctl toggle proxy-new-routing --env=prod --off --reason 'canary 5xx spike'
```
deploy-bot: feature flag proxy-new-routing set to OFF (by derek) at 2026-09-14T19:33:12Z

incident-bot: NOTE: Canary alert resolved (error_rate back below threshold) :white_check_mark:

alex_chen: rolling back canary config to previous commit for those hosts, will monitor.

maria: creating incident ticket with timeline and adding customer-impact list. linking temporary dashboard to correlate tags: https://dd.example.com/dash/xyz-slo-alerts

katie_support: added affected customers to incident notes and queued proactive outreach.

sre-rotation: suggested follow-ups: 1) standardize tag keys across dashboards/alerts (env vs region naming), 2) add canary smoke test that verifies X-Session-Affinity header is honored, 3) reduce alert flapping during rollouts by enforcing per-policy aggregation and a 5m dedupe window.

derek: agree on follow-ups. root cause: config change introduced reliance on a header not present for all traffic + observability tag mismatch. will add rollout validation and a runbook step to confirm tag schemas before publish.

alex_chen: handing off monitoring to @oncall-week for the next 45m. will document kill-switch steps in the runbook and attach logs.

oncall-week: ACK — will watch and escalate if anything resurfaces. please attach the rollback commit hash in ticket.

maria: incident closed in thread: Canary mitigated, FF toggled off, rollback applied. follow-ups assigned: dd-tag-schema, canary-affinity-test, runbook-ff-kill.

derek: will follow up with a post-deploy note and update the CI canary smoke test to include header checks.

incident-bot: INCIDENT CLOSED: canary spike mitigated, proactive outreach queued.
